messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Network - Upstream peering instability detected (GigaTransit). Multiple BGP withdraws/announces for our eu-west prefixes in the last 2m. Severity: P1. Paging: @alex. Link: https://monitoring.redwood/api/alerts/1769123456

alex: acked :phone: I'll join. seeing repeated AS_PATH changes, high prefix churn. starting capture.

priya: I'm on network. can you paste dump of bgp updates?

alex: grabbing now. partial dump:
```
BGP UPDATE from 203.0.113.45: WITHDRAW 198.51.100.0/24
BGP UPDATE from 203.0.113.45: ANNOUNCE 198.51.100.0/24 AS_PATH: 64512 64513 64514
BGP UPDATE from 203.0.113.46: ANNOUNCE 198.51.100.0/24 AS_PATH: 64512 64514
packet loss to 203.0.113.45 ~ 12%
```

marta: are prefixes all customer-facing? which services hit?

jordan-cs: customer-impact: initial telemetry shows increased 5xx for auth and embeddings endpoints for customers in eu-west1 and eu-west2. ~30% of requests failing, some timeouts. CS already getting inbound tickets flagged as "region outage".

kyler: can we shift default route preference to CloudLink peering temporarily? we have spare capacity there.

seb-network: recommended path: set local_pref higher on CloudLink-bound sessions for affected prefixes and remove the problematic next-hop from RIB if persistent. i'll coordinate with provider.

priya: plan: (1) announce mitigation and handoff to network team; (2) move critical prefixes to secondary peering via CloudLink (soft-preference change); (3) if instability persists, withdraw the specific problematic prefix toward GigaTransit; (4) update status and CS. executing step 2 now.

alex: performing soft-preference change via controller runbook. command:
```sh
# raise local-pref for CloudLink session for eu-west prefixes
redwood-netctl bgp modify --peer cloudlink --prefix 198.51.100.0/24 --local-pref 200
```

alex: applied. propagating.. watching RIB and traffic.

incident-bot: Event: route-change applied by alex (runbook ref: net-rr-004).

marta: traffic shift observed. backend latency dropping for some customers. 5xx rate down from 30% -> 12% for auth calls. still some mid-packet loss.

kyler: ok keep it for now. seb, can you open a ticket with GigaTransit and ask for root cause? share pcap and timestamps.

seb-network: opened ticket GT-8921 with full bgp dump + pcap. asked for immediate peering investigation.

jordan-cs: informing affected customers via status page draft (sending to ops for approval):
"We are investigating network disruptions affecting customers in eu-west. We have implemented a traffic reroute to reduce impact. Some requests may still see elevated errors. We'll update as we have more info."

priya: monitoring metrics: still seeing intermittent flaps every ~90s from GigaTransit. next step if flaps return: withdraw the specific prefixes from GigaTransit completely and force all traffic CloudLink. needs approval from oncall and PM.

alex: +1 for withdraw if it persists. we should also prepare rollback of soft-pref in case CloudLink saturates.

marta: Ops note: enabling additional autoscale on frontends servicing eu-west so transient errors don't cascade.

(around +8m)

incident-bot: Update: GigaTransit reports "packet loss on one of our core PoPs affecting peering" and are executing an internal reroute. ETA 30-45m.

seb-network: received updated MRT from GT; they show interface errors at PoP LON2. continuing to push for fix.

kyler: coordinate with infra to keep a close eye on CloudLink utilization. set alert thresholds: 70% across any egress link -> pause withdraw actions.

priya: acknowledged. set soft-alerts and watch.

(around +40m)

alex: GigaTransit confirms fix deployed at LON2. BGP updates stabilized. we're seeing RIB convergence and reduced churn. traffic metrics returning to baseline over last 10m.

jordan-cs: CS update: escalate notices closed. informing customers we've seen a transient peering incident, mitigation applied, and we've confirmed recovery.

marta: post-incident actions:
- create postmortem (owner: priya)
- include packet captures and exact timestamps in GT ticket
- review peering SLAs and consider automated reroute policy for future
- test CloudLink capacity with planned load test

priya: assigning postmortem ticket PM-1184. will draft and share within 24h.

alex: handed back to normal oncall. removing P1 status. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed by alex. Duration ~42m.
